description: Offline semantic linter for recipes/*.json. Checks schema, id/filename match, duplicate node names, unknown operator types, dangling connections, bad parents, render-outside-geometryCOMP, missing parameter nodes, unresolved control bind_to, GLSL uniforms on non-GLSL hosts, and hygiene (tags/description/preview_description). Returns a structured report; never calls TouchDesigner.

fail_on.description: Severity at which the tool returns isError (CLI maps to exit code).

recipe_id.description: If set, lint only this one recipe (matched by id); otherwise lint all.

rules.description: Subset of rule ids to run; default runs every rule.

severity.description: Minimum severity to include in the result.

name: lint_recipe_library
title: Lint recipe library
